Container.Name: Nexus
Container.Overview: Household second brain: Obsidian-style linked Markdown notes, Tana-style supertags, Notion-style table/board databases, spaced-repetition flashcards for cert prep, homelab service health checks, and a shared household calendar with Google Calendar / Outlook two-way sync and an ICS feed for your phones. Single container, all data in one SQLite file under /data.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port on your Unraid server for the web UI. 8090 avoids the common 8080 clash with qBittorrent/UniFi.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database (nexus.db) and nightly backups (backups/). Include this folder in your appdata backups.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The https address you reach Nexus at from outside, e.g. https://tower.tail1234.ts.net or https://nexus.example.com. Required for Google/Outlook sign-in. Leave empty for LAN-only use.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Ask Claude. Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API keys (pay-as-you-go; a Claude.ai subscription can't be used).

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: Model for Ask Claude. claude-opus-5-5 (best), claude-sonnet-5-5 (about half the price) or claude-haiku-5-5 (cheapest).

Config.Name: Claude web access
Config.Description: on = Ask Claude can search the web and read web pages (runs on Anthropic's side; small per-search charge). off = notes and calendar only.

Config.Name: Claude effort
Config.Description: How hard Claude thinks: low, medium, high. Higher is slower and costs more.

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Enables two-way Google Calendar sync (see unraid/README.md).

Config.Name: Microsoft client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Enables two-way Outlook / Microsoft 365 sync.

Config.Name: Microsoft tenant
Config.Description: common = work + personal accounts, consumers = Outlook.com only, or a tenant ID.

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Nightly database snapshots kept in /data/backups. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Calendar sync interval (min)
Config.Description: How often Google/Outlook/ICS calendars are pulled.

Config.Name: Service check interval (s)
Config.Description: How often #service URLs are pinged.

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP host
Config.Description: Email notifications: your mail provider's SMTP server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 (STARTTLS) or 465 (TLS)

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP user
Config.Description: Usually your email address

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP password
Config.Description: For Gmail/iCloud use an app password

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP from
Config.Description: e.g. Nexus <you@gmail.com>

Config.Name: Notify: Pushover app token
Config.Description: Optional: Pushover application token

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: Your Unraid web UI address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10 – shows array/disks/containers on Home

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Settings → Management Access → API Keys (read access)

Config.Name: Backup: S3 endpoint
Config.Description: Off-server backups, e.g. https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com

Config.Name: Backup: S3 bucket
Config.Description: Bucket name

Config.Name: Backup: S3 region
Config.Description: e.g. us-west-004 for Backblaze B2

Config.Name: Backup: S3 key ID
Config.Description: Access key / application key ID

Config.Name: Backup: S3 secret
Config.Description: Secret / application key

Config.Name: Backup: passphrase
Config.Description: Encrypts off-server backups (required for cloud). Store it safely – backups can't be restored without it.

Config.Name: Weekly review
Config.Description: on/off – Sunday 18:00 weekly review note

Config.Name: Backup: copy to folder
Config.Description: Optional: a folder on another disk/share for encrypted backup copies. Also set BACKUP_COPY_DIR=/backup-copy below.

Config.Name: Backup: copy dir (inside container)
Config.Description: Set to /backup-copy if you mapped the folder above
